author: Unreal Engine
description:
Discover how MegaLights in Unreal Engine 5.8 can transform the way you light your environments with thousands of dynamic, shadow-casting lights while maintaining performance.

Now Production Ready in Unreal Engine 5.8, MegaLights enables more flexible lighting workflows, helping you create richly illuminated environments with realistic shadows and greater creative freedom.

In this Epic Games Office Hours webinar, you'll learn what MegaLights is, why you should use it, and how to get started.

Follow us on Linkedin for more upcoming webinars: https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/unreal-engine-for-design-visualization
